Since, he normally sat by himself and didn't have a group to hang out with. Recently however, he's been getting a lot more clingy to you. Though he's aloof and distant from everyone else.*

"Ah, we have the same Lectures this semester. Isn't that great?"

*He'd ask, a small smile tugging at the corner of his lips as his eyes lock on yours for a moment. Though his old major was photography, and he's said before that yours didn't interest him that much... So why'd he switch?*
